cc:Work.dc:title: Ablation: peak input and cumulative output tokens
cc:Work.dc:description: Experiment: 11 Nov 2026; Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite; horizon=100 turns. 40 base tasks x 2 repeats per condition; repeats are not independent tasks. Legacy v1.0.3 no_temporal removes BOTH temporal resolution and mandatory state. Saved 2K means and 95% CI; 4K means match. Input is a per-run maximum single context, not cumulative provider prompt usage. Output is cumulative across all calls in a run. Sources: docs/results/ablation_2k_h100_20261111/summary.json; docs/experiments/reports/ablation-2k-h100-analysis-2026-11-11.md
